name.ja: HG 1/24 霊子戦闘機・無限(クラリス機)

description.ja: 『新サクラ大戦』より、「霊子戦闘機・無限（クラリス機）」がHGにラインアップ！
description.en: From "New Sakura Wars ", " Reiko Fighter Mugen (Clarice Machine)" is added to the HG lineup!

description.ja: ■コックピットハッチにオープンギミックを搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with an open gimmick on the cockpit hatch.

description.ja: ■アクションポーズの幅が広がる延長ギミックを手・足の関節部分に採用。手足の伸縮が可能に。
description.en: • Extension gimmicks are used in the joints of the hands and feet to expand the range of action poses. Allows limbs to expand and contract.

description.ja: ■閉じた魔導書、開いた魔導書が付属。
description.en: • Comes with closed and open spellbooks.

description.ja: ■開いた魔導書のページ部分は、取扱説明書を切り出して再現。
description.en: • The pages of the opened magic book are reproduced by cutting out the instruction manual.

description.ja: ■搭乗姿のキャラクターフィギュアが付属。
description.en: • A character figure in boarding form is included.

accessories.ja: 魔導書×2種（閉じた魔導書、開いた魔導書）
accessories.en: Magic book x 2 types (closed magic book, open magic book)
